en.title: Migration Agency pauses certain teen deportations
en.summary: The Migration Agency is temporarily pausing certain so-called teen deportations. This concerns deportations of young adults whose parents and underage siblings have the right to remain in Sweden. The background is announced legislative changes that could give more people in this group the right to stay.

De långdragna regeringsförhandlingarna är förklaringen, enligt Per Oleskog Tryggvason på Indikator Opinion som gjort undersökningen.

en.title: Centre Party drops in new poll: "Not surprising"
en.summary: Support for the Centre Party is falling in a new poll. The party gets 4.8 percent, just above the threshold for entering the Riksdag. The Social Democrats get their worst figure since 2023. The protracted government negotiations are the explanation, according to Per Oleskog Tryggvason at Indikator Opinion, who conducted the survey.
